wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/fix_flock_would_block.py: """`flock`'s would-block output was stored as a RAW word into a slot that may hold a boxed value.

`flock($h, LOCK_SH, $would)` on an undeclared `$would` gives that variable a `mixed` slot holding a
boxed null. The raw store writes the integer 0 over the box pointer, and reading it back as a boxed
value answers NULL — php answers `int(0)`.

The socket builtins already solved this: `store_int_output_to_local` boxes when the slot is
`Mixed`, stores directly when it is `Int`/`Bool`, and REFUSES anything else rather than writing a
